missingMember: Supply an email or both first and last names for an existing member.
missingPlan: Choose an existing plan by name or ID.
missingDueDate: Supply the next billing date from the previous system.
invalidDate: Use a real calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format.
invalidPrice: Enter a nonnegative whole number of cents, at most 2147483647.
invalidInterval: Use monthly or annual for the billing interval.
invalidDay: Billing day must be a whole number from 1 to 31.
invalidStatus: Import active renewals only; manage trials, freezes and cancellations separately.
unknownMember: No existing member matches this identity.
ambiguousMember: Several members match; supply names or a birth date to identify one member.
unknownPlan: No active plan matches this name or ID.
ambiguousPlan: Several plans have this name; map the plan ID instead.
currencyMismatch: The imported currency must match the plan currency.
duplicateRow: This member and plan already appear in row {row}.
billingDayConflict: Monthly renewals in a household must share one billing day, allowing shorter months.
existingScheduleConflict: An existing monthly membership uses another billing day; review the household's schedule first.
immutableMembership: Only active or pending memberships can be updated by this import.
beforeStartsOn: The next billing date cannot be before the membership start date.
invalidAnnualDay: For annual renewals, billing day must match the due date's day, except 29 for February 28 in a non-leap year.
